notices.title: IMPORTANT: upgrade to 0.1.16
notices.message: Older versions break the DeepSeek prefix cache and waste tokens (hit rate drops to single digits). 0.1.16 rewrote the cache strategy — no more wasted tokens. Upgrade: npm install @a9i5k4/dsh-auto-memory@latest (pnpm users on release day: use @0.1.16 explicitly)
